== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Enosh]] [[Grandmasters]] are high-ranking leaders and powerful combatants within the city of [[Enosh]]. They function as a significant military force and hold [[Authority|authority]] through a council that meets in a specialized war room located within the [[Grandmasters' palace]] at the city's center. This council utilizes a large [[stone]] table and is represented by various banners, each signifying the specific Territories that the individual [[Grandmasters]] command. Notable members include [[Naraka]], an elderly woman and mist-binder who has taught [[Alin]]; [[Avernus]], a stern woman with silver hair; and [[Endross]], a man characterized by a dangerous, restrained grace. The [[Grandmasters]] possess the ability to Travel through [[Gates]] to reach their respective Territories and are capable of engaging in high-level combat. While they act as mentors to some, their leadership is also marked by strict prohibitions and complex emotional reactions to the actions of others. They are driven by a belief that they are acting for the greater good, specifically in their opposition to the tyranny of [[Damasca]].}}
